novelty_review.scope: Internal engineering review for native validation; not external acceptance
novelty_review.rationale: The redesigned task balances a freely pivoted loaded service arm by changing the counterweight moment, then pins the sliding weight against drift. The robot must support the arm during adjustment and leave it balanced after release.
novelty_review.risk: Moderate overlap in balancing. Correct behavior must come from gravitational moments and the free pin rather than a hidden centering actuator.

review_notes: Passive mechanics, source-defined contact geometry, measured-state controller and native probes implemented. Offline geometry cannot establish physical success. No task may enter the submission handoff before runtime evidence passes.
